findings.title: The dated export can report success after emitting invalid or value-losing metadata YAML
findings.evidence:
scripts/install.py:330-376 inserts moved keys into an existing metadata block without parsing its indentation or checking nested-key collisions. A valid four-space metadata child transforms into `metadata:
  disable-model-invocation: true
    owner: idc`, which PyYAML rejects with `mapping values are not allowed here`. If metadata already contains `disable-model-invocation: false`, a top-level `disable-model-invocation: true` transforms into duplicate nested keys; PyYAML resolves the exported metadata value to false, so the moved true value is not preserved as an addressable value. Both transforms return successfully.
findings.recompute: At reviewed commit, call `transform_claude_ai_frontmatter` on (a) metadata with a four-space `owner` child plus top-level `disable-model-invocation: true`, and (b) metadata already containing `disable-model-invocation: false` plus the top-level true value; parse each transformed frontmatter with `yaml.safe_load`. Case (a) is invalid and case (b) resolves the moved key to false.

findings.title: Native SHA verification false-greens executable-mode drift and refuses to repair it
findings.evidence: tree_manifest at scripts/install.py:214-240 hashes path, kind, size, and bytes but omits POSIX mode. On WSL/ext4, install a source `scripts/run.sh` at 0755, chmod the installed copy to 0644, then verify: success=true and skill status=verified. A normal rerun reports unchanged and leaves mode 0644. The current repo contains thirteen 100755 skill scripts, so this is product-relevant rather than hypothetical.
findings.recompute: On POSIX/WSL, create a minimal skill with `scripts/run.sh` chmod 0755; run `run_install`; chmod `<target>/alpha/scripts/run.sh` to 0644; run `run_install(..., verify_only=True)` and then normal `run_install`. Observe verified/unchanged and final mode 0644. Confirm affected canonical modes with `git ls-tree -r b1ab04c31015b11a086020fa3a4d0d01654127e6 skills | grep '100755.*scripts/'`.

findings.title: Run-level preflight is not transactional and leaves partial installs
findings.evidence: run_install claims `All inputs are validated before any write` at scripts/install.py:560, but destination shape validation occurs inside `_sync_skill` during the write loop. With valid alpha and beta sources, an empty target, and a blocking regular file at `<target>/beta`, alpha is installed first; beta then errors with `skill destination is not a directory`. The report correctly fails, but `<target>/alpha` remains newly installed. The fleet can therefore be left on mixed skill versions.
findings.recompute: Create source skills alpha and beta; create target directory containing a regular file named beta; call `run_install(source, [TargetSpec('custom', target)])`; assert report.success is false and `<target>/alpha/SKILL.md` nevertheless exists.

findings.title: An explicitly selected absent Claude or Pi target is skipped with exit-success
findings.evidence: default_targets marks Claude and Pi optional, and run_install checks optional absence before considering whether the target was explicitly selected. `select_targets(home, ['claude'])` followed by dry-run or install against an absent `~/.claude/skills` returns target status `skipped-absent`, zero operated skills, report.success=true, and CLI exit 0. Explicit target selection therefore does not perform the requested install.
findings.recompute: With a temporary home lacking `.claude/skills`, select only Claude via `select_targets(home, ['claude'])`; call `run_install` for one valid skill. Observe `skipped-absent`, no skill results, and success=true. The CLI equivalent is `python scripts/install.py --repo-root <fixture> install --target claude --skill alpha --dry-run --json`.

findings.title: Windows locale encoding can crash JSON output after a successful write
findings.evidence: main prints `json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False)` through locale-default stdout at scripts/install.py:950. On the default cp1252 Windows seat, installing to a custom path containing U+4E2D writes the skill successfully, then raises UnicodeEncodeError while printing JSON. The process exits 1 with a traceback, emits no JSON, and leaves the target mutated. A cp1252-representable non-ASCII path emits non-UTF-8 JSON bytes, also breaking UTF-8 consumers.
findings.recompute: On Windows with cp1252 stdout, invoke the CLI using `--custom-target buzz=<temp>/target-中 --skill alpha --json` against a valid fixture. Capture bytes. Observe return code 1, empty stdout, UnicodeEncodeError on stderr, and `<target>/alpha/SKILL.md` present.

findings.title: The advertised fleet topology is not documented in user-visible help
findings.evidence: The module docstring calls the topology documented, but `install --help` only lists target aliases. It does not state the resolved paths (`~/.agents/skills`, `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.pi/agent/skills`, `~/.hermes/skills`), conditional-vs-independent behavior, or that absent Claude/Pi targets are silently skipped. `--home` is suppressed. A user cannot predict the external write set from the CLI contract.
findings.recompute: Run `python scripts/install.py install --help` at the reviewed commit and compare the output with `default_targets` at scripts/install.py:411-419.
